#: canopy-sandbox's template for review_cmd, canopy's reviewer, which reads a PR's checkout and writes nothing
(HOST_ISOLATION §4.4). canopy sandbox setup copies it to ~/.config/canopy/sandbox/review.json; fill in your hosts
there. Keys starting with # are comments; @NAME@ strings are the paths canopy-sandbox fills in for each run.
Everything not listed is refused. Add your model provider's API host and the MCP services the reviewer reads
the PR and its ticket from. It pushes nothing and fetches nothing, so github.com itself is not listed.
The reviewer starts in <workspace>/.canopy/reviews/<id>/, which links to the checkout. The checkout and its git
directories are readable and not writable: the diff it reads was written by the PR's author. If your
workspace is outside HOME, add it to denyRead.
